intro: I am a software engineer with over five years of expertise dedicated to architecting high-performance enterprise backend web applications, alongside more than two years specialized in modern AI engineering.
My work centers on utilizing the intersection of both disciplines, transforming experimental GenAI capabilities and agentic AI workflows into scalable production AI infrastructure.

I specialize in RAG architectures, LLM orchestration, and autonomous AI agents, with a proven track record of directing remote teams and spearheading scalable microservices development in Agile environments.

expertise.title: Enterprise Backend & Microservices
expertise.description: Architecting high-performance enterprise web applications, managing API lifecycles, and spearheading scalable microservices and distributed database systems.

expertise.title: GenAI & LLM Orchestration
expertise.description: Transforming experimental GenAI capabilities into scalable production AI infrastructure, focusing heavily on RAG architectures and deep LLM integration.

expertise.title: Autonomous AI Agents & Workflows
expertise.description: Deploying intelligent AI chatbots and designing robust, production-ready agentic workflows with strict evaluation standards to ensure reliable and deterministic performance.
